en.topic_title: Trump offered to sell arms to Xi: US ambassador to Fox News
en.topic_summary:
US President Donald Trump offered to sell arms to his Chinese counterpart Xi Jinping in response to concern over weapons sales to Taiwan, the US ambassador to China said in a Fox News interview that aired Sunday.



US President Donald Trump shakes hands with China’s President Xi Jinping after a visit with First Lady Melania Trump and China’s First Lady Peng Liyuan to the National Archives in Washington, DC on September 25, 2026. Photo: Saul Loeb/AFP.
